item.title: Russia fixes launch pad damaged by Thanksgiving astronaut launch to the International Space Station
item.description: Russia has fixed Site 31 at Baikonur Cosmodrome, the only pad supporting the nation's human spaceflight missions. It had been out of commission since late November.

item.title: Antarctica has lost 5,000 square miles of 'grounded ice' in the last 30 years, satellite images reveal
item.description: Antarctica has lost nearly 5,000 square miles of "grounded ice" in 30 years, as warming ocean waters drive retreat in vulnerable regions, a new study finds.

item.title: SpaceX Starlink launch creates gorgeous 'jellyfish' in predawn Florida skies (video, photos)
item.description: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket carrying 29 Starlink satellites launched from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida on Wednesday (March 4), creating a sky show for early risers.

item.title: Auroras on Jupiter's giant moon Ganymede look like Earth's northern lights, NASA spacecraft reveals
item.description: Ganymede's auroras splinter into small, bright patches — structures that mirror features seen in Earth's own auroral displays.

item.title: 'War of the Worlds' in reverse? Mars dirt could help fight off a microbial invasion from Earth
item.description: Tests conducted with tardigrades suggest that there is something in Martian dirt that dramatically reduces biological activity.
